Instrument.name: Terrain Mapping Camera
Instrument.description: Terrain Mapping Camera (TMC) is one of the scientific instrument hosted on the Chandrayaan-1 Orbiter. The instrument is passive electro-optical imaging camera operating in visible-panchromatic band (500-800nm), comprising three optical sensors Fore, Nadir and Aft placed with angles of +25 deg, 0 deg and -25 deg to have three stereo views of the same target as spacecraft moves along the track.
